menu.note: logit correction = rel_next_day*(log x_nd - log x_fast) + rel_within_3_days*(log x_w3 - log x_fast) for slower genuinely-quoted options; x_eff = x_fast*exp(-corr/slope)

prior.note: state prior for OnlineCompetitor: level is relative to the A-const baseline world; the absolute acceptance threshold for a typical request is exp(level + A + lane) ~ 1.44x list.

effective.note: implied = world average acceptance threshold over that world's requests (includes the request mix and the dealer speed value); level-state sd is the pure level spread, matching the rules uniform range 1.26-1.54.
